en.title: Tides of Iron and the Amber Decree
en.premise: The sudden death of the old emperor leaves a void in the imperial succession. As a regent imposes an iron-fisted rule, a concealed 'lost letter' and a 'secret map' promising untold riches emerge as catalysts that threaten to shatter the world's balance. Ambitious merchants, generals torn by loyalty, and spies chasing the truth become inextricably entwined within the torrent of power. A sweeping saga depicting how the fragments of history converge into a single, monumental upheaval.

zh.title: 铁之潮流与琥珀诏令
zh.premise: 老皇帝猝然离世，帝国继承权陷入权力真空。在摄政王推行强权政治之际，一封被掩盖的“失踪信件”与一张许诺无尽财富的“秘密地图”，化作动摇世界平衡的引信开始运转。心怀野心的商人、在忠义间挣扎的将军、以及追寻真相的密探，在权力的洪流中错综复杂地交织在一起。这是一部描绘历史碎片如何汇聚成一场巨大变革的群像史诗。
